title: AIDE corpus item
description: One scenario in the AIDE corpus. A scenario is a decision point plus a measurement instrument. The aid model sees packet, constraints, and decision_point. It does NOT see options, codings, or the coding key. The principal scaffold sees packet, constraints, decision_point, and options in shuffled presentation order.

binding_uncertainty.description: Which uncertainty the decision actually turns on. Varied across the corpus so it is not measuring one epistemic structure twelve times.

packet.description: 400-800 words of situation. Open-source-derivable detail only. Synthetic, undated.

text.description: Prose action as shown to the principal. Carries no rung, type, or reversibility label.

rung.description: Coercive commitment toward the adversary. NOT magnitude of effort or resource cost.

reversibility_note.description: Why. Required for any option whose reversibility does not track its rung.

rung_range.description: [min, max] over this item's options. Denominator for normalized position.

high_salience.description: Fills the [scenario-specific position] slot in the standing statement.

divergence.description: Whether the personal-optimal and national-optimal options coincide. At least four of twelve must be divergent.

brief_mapping_notes.description: How to map an aid brief's recommended actions onto this item's option indices for variant B scoring.

defensible_set.description: Options the author judges defensible under the standing utility statement. Calibration test: this must contain 2-4 members. Never shown to any model.
